 December 16, 2025

 Notice is given under Section 22.2(3) of the Forest and Range Practices Act,

 Effective immediately and until further notice a variance to the notice of closure of
 the Hunter Creek Forest Service Road FSR (6086.01) issued December 15, 2025, is
 given to the road users listed below for the purposes stipulated.

 The variance is to provide access and use of the FSR beyond structure CK-2157 and
 is limited to Hunter Creek Hydro Power L.P. Logging Ltd. (holder of Road Use
 Permit # 6086-16-02). Structure CK-2157 remains CLOSED and requires further
 assessment before any vehicle crossings can be authorized.
 Forest and Range Practices Act
  Non-industrial use of a road
  22.2 (1)Subject to subsections (2) to (4) and to regulations respecting
  roads made under the Industrial Roads Act, a road that is
  (a)a forest service road, or
  (b)authorized under a road permit or a woodlot licence

  may be used by any person without charge for a purpose other than a
  timber harvesting purpose, silviculture purpose or natural resource
  development purpose.
  (2) The
  (a)district manager, for a forest service road, or
  (b)holder of a road permit or a woodlot licence, for a road
  under the permit or licence,

  may take action under subsection (3) if
  (c)use of the road under subsection (1) would likely
  (i) cause significant damage to the road,
  (ii) cause significant sediment delivery, or
  (iii) endanger property, public health or public safety,
  or
  (d)the presence on the road of a vehicle or animal would likely
  cause damage to the road or environment or endanger life or
  property.
  (3) In the circumstances described in subsection (2),
  (a)the district manager, for a forest service road, may
Ministry of Forests  Chilliwack Forest District  46360 Airport Road
  Chilliwack, BC V2P 1A5
  Phone: (604) 702-5700
  Fax: (604) 702-5711

  (i)close the road or restrict its use, or
  (ii)remove a vehicle or an animal from the road at the
  expense of the owner of the vehicle or animal, and
  (b)the holder of a road permit or a woodlot licence, for a road
  under the permit or licence,
  (i)with the prior consent of the minister, may close the
  road or restrict its use, or
  (ii)may remove a vehicle or an animal from the road at
  the expense of the owner of the vehicle or animal.

Once the District Manager is satisfied that the elements of worker safety and
environmental management have been adequately addressed, they may further
vary or rescind the notice of closure to allow other industrial operations to resume
and allow for non-industrial use of an FSR.

Please check Chilliwack's Forest Service Road Safety Information web page for
Forest Service Road advisories and closure updates.
https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/industry/natural-resource-use/resource-
roads/local-road-safety-information/chilliwack-natural-resource-district-district-
road-safety-information

All resource road users are advised to check local weather and safety advisories, drive
to the condition of the road and watch for hazards if heading into the backcountry.

Thank you for your patience and cooperation during this time.




Randall Dayton
A/District Manager
Chilliwack Forest District




Ministry of Forests  Chilliwack Forest District  46360 Airport Road
  Chilliwack, BC V2P 1A5
